The '''Lazerian army''' was a standing army on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]]. An elite paramilitary unit of the army was the [[King's Own Guard]]; they were most trained and efficient [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in the army. Lazerian army troops assisted [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] troops in garrisoning the planet's industrial [[Spaceport/Legends|starports]].
